description: Main window only (not onboarding): a finished call's records. Its summary built again and stopped (summary_build, summary_cancel); its proposals and their review (proposals_list, proposals_for_person, proposal_decide, proposal_undo); its task cards (call_cards, call_card_update); its recordings with the transcript and its questions with their moments (call_transcript, call_questions); the search over the calls and the history's rows (calls_search, calls_overview); and its audio: the waveform (recording_peaks; the files play through the grill-audio scheme, main window only) and «Удалить запись» (call_audio_delete).
